items.text: The Context page now carries the spousal violence figures from the 2023-24 round of the National Family Health Survey, by state, beside the 2019-21 figure printed next to them. They fell in 29 of the 34 states and union territories with a figure and rose in 5. The fact sheets are provisional, and the page says what that means for the largest changes.
The States page has a new chart that sets each state's recorded rate against its own rate in an earlier year, for any of the 13 crimes and any starting year from 2017 to 2023.
The States page now opens with a By region section, one card for each of the six regions, and the North-East is one of them. Each card goes to that region's rows on the Regions page.
Type, spacing, table rows and buttons were refined across the site. No page changed its content.

The Context page now carries the National Commission for Women's complaints for 2025: 27,672, of which 14,028 came from Uttar Pradesh. The National Crime Records Bureau has not published a 2025 report, so the Commission's figures are the only national count for that year. Each one is a complaint a woman chose to send to the Commission.
A What's new page and a Corrections page, so that changes to the site and to its figures and claims have a public record.
The North-East page sets the eight North-Eastern states side by side.
The Regions page groups every state and union territory by Zonal Council, with a total for each region, and sets beside them the nine capital cities that NCRB reports.
The Protests page lists six marches and protests reported between 1 September and 6 October 2026, each with the report that gives its date.
Every state page now says what share of its cases were booked under POCSO, against India as a whole.
The Data and method page now says why the figures stop at 2024.
Who the offender was in rape and POCSO cases, rape by section of law, people arrested and tried, and the 19 largest cities, for 2020 to 2024.
Rape of Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe women and girls, 2021 to 2024, from NCRB's Volume 2.
Girls' ages under POCSO, set beside rape victims by age.
An explanation of why women appear among the people arrested for rape.
Every crime and state page has its own link preview when shared, and the site has a sitemap.
How the numbers are made, on how NCRB counts a case and what its counting rule leaves out.
Where a woman's case is lost, which follows a case from the violence to the verdict.
The site is now Women on Record, at www.womenonrecord.net.
The law page sets each crime's section in the Indian Penal Code beside its section in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
The data now runs from 2014 and the charts from 2017.
A data explorer puts every figure in one table that can be filtered, sorted and downloaded.
Police figures for 1 January 2024 from the Bureau of Police Research and Development.
The Context page, which sets eight other sources beside NCRB's figures.
The Protests page, on the cases and marches of September 2026.
Terms and privacy.
